follow-up time: Variable, up to death or last follow-up
exposure: Initial surgical procedure (cesarean section vs. hysterectomy)
cohort: 15 women with abdominal burst after obstetric surgical procedures (out of 3,914 procedures performed).
finding: Recurrent abdominal burst occurred in one-third of women with initial abdominal burst, highlighting the need for multidisciplinary care and optimal management of risk factors like anemia, hypoalbuminemia, and autoimmune diseases.
